historical_familiarity_family_1.mechanism: Supervised CNN penultimate features -> 1024-bit LSH code -> kNN master library, k=15, Hamming-distance classification.
historical_familiarity_family_1.mapping: Direct historical predecessor to prototype/familiarity readout ideas; candidate measurement foundation for MVC-0 style prototypes, not a user-specific online learning contract by itself.

historical_familiarity_family_2.mechanism: Game-of-Life-derived pattern signatures with synthetic archetype library plus data-driven clustering of real images; nearest-cluster similarity and interpretable phrase labels, with historical match thresholds around 0.92-0.93.
historical_familiarity_family_2.mapping: Pattern/dictionary/familiarity lineage relevant to current adaptive visual learner prototype bank and open-set fixtures; historical fixed thresholds are not current acceptance thresholds.

calibration_failure_lineage.finding: Historical comments record false-positive feedback and manual threshold changes, including a sauna classifier threshold raised from 0.18 to 0.25 plus other Llama-4-guided vocabulary/threshold tuning.
calibration_failure_lineage.mapping: Preserve as negative/calibration regression fixtures; do not inherit hand-tuned thresholds as current truth.

security_and_provenance_findings.finding: URL image ingestion uses urllib.request.urlopen with timeout and size cap but no observed host/scheme allowlist in the inspected core path. If exposed to untrusted callers this is an SSRF/network-reachability surface.
security_and_provenance_findings.current_requirement: Current runtime ingress must enforce explicit URL/network authority policy or disable arbitrary remote fetch by default.

security_and_provenance_findings.finding: Historical model/library loading uses torch.load(..., weights_only=False). Untrusted serialized model artifacts can execute code through pickle semantics.
security_and_provenance_findings.current_requirement: Only load trusted hash/signature-verified legacy artifacts or migrate imported weights/state to a non-code-executing format.

security_and_provenance_findings.finding: Secret-file names are present in the archive. Their values were intentionally not fetched or copied into RAE.
security_and_provenance_findings.current_requirement: Preserve secret provenance without semantic ingestion of credential values.

security_and_provenance_findings.finding: Generated build output and vendored dependencies are materially large archive units and must be denominator-accounted separately from authored Retina semantics.

current_contract_mapping.fixed_target: Dissolved Clay-native visual semantics with physical conventional backing; adaptive user-specific Micro Visual Classifier; calibrated known/unknown/conflict routing; bounded cyclic updates; provenance, rollback and no execution authority from familiarity.
current_contract_mapping.implication: Historical kNN/LSH and GoL pattern libraries are implementation/measurement ancestors, not permission to preserve a separate semantic vision service or to treat similarity as sensor truth.
